name: PSA Security Guard Practice Test
fullName: QQI Level 4 Security Guarding Skills (4N20604) for the PSA security guard licence
notes: The PSA's Private Security (Licensing and Qualifications) Regulations 2022 (S.I. 574/2022, amended by S.I. 204/2024) set QQI Level 4 minor award 4N20604 Security Guarding Skills, or an equivalent, for the security guard (guarding) licence. QQI's component specification for 4N20604 sets a theory examination worth 50% and a skills demonstration worth 50%, both of which must be passed, graded Pass 50-64%, Merit 65-79%, Distinction 80-100%; the assessor (the training provider) writes the paper, so no question count or time is published. Tigertest models the theory examination: four 50-question mock tests with 70% as Tigertest's readiness target. Categories follow the award's two units (1 Private Security Sector, 2 Security Guarding Skills) and its learning outcomes; weights are Tigertest's. Content sets, so sets first, then tests.
